## What
<!-- One sentence: the smallest version of the feature. -->

## Why
<!-- What gap does this close? What workflow does it unblock? Cite the bundled skill or persona belief if applicable. -->

## Sizing
<!-- Per the sizing rule (trace + sem + grep, NEVER hours): -->

- **probe:** `grep ... | wc -l`
- **expected scope:** ≤3 files (micro) | 4–15 files (split) | ≥16 files (plan)
- **canonical-source convergence:** does any upstream plugin (coding-skills, superpowers, remember) already do this?

## Out of scope
<!-- What this feature is NOT. Helps reviewers stay focused. -->
